title: NSA Glomar response cites Executive Order 13526

tellings.quote: their exact response, "This agency has determined that the fact of the existence or non-existence [music] of the material you request is a currently improperly classified matter

plain: In 2023 the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, answered a researcher's records request about UFOs by refusing to say whether any records even exist, a kind of reply known as a Glomar response. Jesse Michels reads it on the show: the request was filed by a researcher named Noah Hradek under the US law that lets anyone ask for government records, and the reply cites Executive Order 13526, a presidential order on classified information, saying that "the fact of the existence or non-existence of the material you request is a currently improperly classified matter." Michels raises it as a sign the agency is guarding something on the subject.
